title: 第1章 美女房东催租
content_zh:
盛夏的天气就像盛怒的漂亮女人，那份灼热让人头昏目眩，再加上呈喷射状往外飞溅的吐沫星子，仿佛久旱大地普降甘霖。

此时徐青正穿着背心短裤，昏昏沉沉低头站在门口忍受着美女房东热情洋溢的吐沫攻势，连脚下也好像踩着浮云，云里雾里思绪飘荡。

美女房东三十出头，长得艳若桃李，绝对属于熟透了往下滴水的那种。一对目测34D的大胸丰硕挺拔，随着情绪的波动微微颤动，煞是诱人。

徐青无心欣赏对面波澜壮阔的旖旎风光，低着头尽量不让吐沫星子喷到脸上，但他也不敢把头缩回去，毕竟他和嫂子欠了人家两个月房租，挨上一顿骂也没啥不应该的，只能低声陪着小心。

“祝大姐……”每当徐青叫出这三个字嗓子眼里总会有些发堵，就像吞了一撮猪毛进去似的，总感觉有些异样。不过这女人的确比他大了一张多，叫声大姐并不掉份，更何况还欠着人家房租呢。

“青子，你也别怨大姐为难你，你去左右打听打听，这房租能拖两个月的也就你这家，要不是看你平时能帮大姐干些不打紧的小活，一早就叫人撵你们出去了。”姓祝的美女房东被这一句大姐叫得大爽，语气也变得柔和了几分，说实话她也不想赶徐青走，毕竟每月人家还能帮着干点‘小活’。

小活？三栋出租房楼道每天打扫一遍，还要帮你换煤气抗米，上回你丫的心脏病犯了还是我背着你上的医院，不过事后连个像样的谢字都无，还怨我扯断了啥吊带……徐青心里骂着，嘴上却不敢蹦出半个字，低着头弱弱的说道：“大姐，我嫂子还没发工资，等十五号一定给行么？”

话虽这样一说，但徐青心里没有半点底气，光靠嫂子每月那一千出头的工资日子过得紧巴巴的，哪有钱来交房租？眼看就要大考了，凭徐青的成绩考上一本大学问题应该不大，可就算考上了，那高昂的学费也没着落。

望着徐青一脸黯然的模样，发泄了一通的美女房东心底莫名一悸，说实话这小伙子还算不错的，那天自己突发心脏病，要不是多亏了他指不定现在呆在哪个四方盒子里赚香烛白菊花呢，喷了他一顿心情也好了不少，一丝叫感激的情绪悄然涌上了心头。

美女房东略一沉吟心里便有了主意，嘴角一弯，一对小梨涡格外诱人，看得徐青神情一荡，竟有些飘了。

“青子，姐也知道你嫂子不容易，要不以后除了打扫楼道外姐再帮你着落一件差事，多少也能填补些费用，做得好一两个月就能把房租还了……”

徐青双眼一亮抬起头来，目不转睛的望祝姐，听到一阵他终于明白了，原来是让他接下周边出租屋的各种琐碎活计，什么换液化气、通下水道管、搬运甚至于中小学生的家教之类，再加上他还会修理些部分电器，如果价格适中的确大有做头。

美女房东越讲越来劲，别看她骂起人来泼辣无比，只要一说起生意经来，那份眼光和智慧让人有种惊艳的感觉，配合着胸前那一对颤巍巍的大胸，更让人叹为观止。

两人就这样屋里屋外的站了快一小时，徐青脚都感觉有些麻了，这才想起要搬条凳子出来给祝大姐坐坐，没想到他刚转身美女房东已经很爽快的一屁股坐到了地上。

徐青听到身后的动静转过头来，脸上的表情骤然一僵，心说，大姐，你就不能坚持一分钟么？

现在倒好，美女房东自个寻了地儿坐下了，徐青反倒呆住了，心里寻思着，这凳子还要不要搬呢？正犹豫着，美女房东坐在地上叫了起来。

“青子，快过来扶姐姐一把，哎呦，我的个腰哦……”

徐青愣了愣，赶紧上前扶起了祝大姐，不料忙中出乱，一只手掌穿过胳肢窝正扣在一团软绵绵的那啥上，这厮脸一红，赶紧把手往回抽了两寸，总算是扶起了祝大姐。

“青子，你可别把姐姐的吊带又扯断了。”美女房东见徐青红了脸，眯着眼打趣道。

“没……这不是那啥，一不小心吧……”徐青一张脸红得像熟透了的番茄，恨不得找个地洞钻下去，只能低着头掩饰住自己的尴尬。

“呵呵！这事就说定了，待会我送个小灵通给你先用着，有活了电话联系……”祝大美女骂也骂够了，还被莫名其妙的捏了一下那啥，心里好像三伏天吃了块小布丁，浑身上下毛孔中都透着舒坦，脸上的笑容那叫一个甜。

“不用了吧！我出不起电话费……”徐青脑海中冒出了一句调儿，手持小灵通，站在风雨中，左手换右手，就是打不通。

“没事，大姐先给你垫着，以后赚了钱再还我就是了。”美女房东心里盘算着自己的小九九，现在经济不景气，租房的也少了许多，三栋出租楼还有大把的房子空着，要是能多一项家政服务，保不齐租房的生意也会蒸蒸日上，咱不是也有了竞争优势了么？

想到这里，美女房东望着徐青结实的身板儿乐了，就这身板儿，比那些干啦吧唧的四眼学生可强多了，瞧瞧这肌肉，啧啧……又想到刚才被这毛头小子捏过的胸脯，丹凤眼中不知不觉多了一层迷蒙蒙的雾气。

“这臭小子也是个老实鼻子空，肚里藏灯芯的主儿，刚才捏那一下差点把我心头那股火勾了起来，唉！我这是怎么了……”美女房东悄悄思忖着，心里浮起一丝莫名的情绪，自从她那死鬼老公英年早逝后还从未有过这种感觉。

心烦意乱的美女房东轻轻用手指揉了揉眉角，将那丝异样的情绪赶了出去，心里这才恢复了平静。
content_en:
The weather in midsummer is like an angry beautiful woman. The scorching heat makes people dizzy. Coupled with the spitting stars flying out in jets, it's like rain falling from the dry land.

At this time, Xu Qing was wearing a tank top and shorts, standing at the door with his head lowered and enduring the passionate spitting attack from the beautiful landlady. Even his feet seemed to be stepping on floating clouds, and his thoughts were floating in the clouds and fog.

The beautiful landlady is in her early thirties. She is as gorgeous as a peach and a plum. She is definitely the kind that will drip when she is ripe.A pair of big breasts that visually measured 34D, plump and straight, trembled slightly with the fluctuation of emotions, which was really tempting.

Xu Qing had no intention of admiring the magnificent and beautiful scenery opposite. He lowered his head and tried not to let the spittle spray hit his face, but he did not dare to pull his head back. After all, he and his sister-in-law owed two months' rent, so there was nothing wrong with being scolded, so he could only whisper and be careful.

"Bless you, sister..." Whenever Xu Qing said these three words, there would always be a lump in his throat, as if he had swallowed a handful of pig hair, and he always felt a little strange.However, this woman is indeed much older than him, so calling her eldest sister is not a loss of status, not to mention she still owes her rent.

"Qingzi, don't blame the elder sister for making things difficult for you. Go and ask around. You are the only one who can delay the rent for two months. If you hadn't seen that you can help the elder sister with some unimportant tasks, I would have kicked you out early in the morning." The beautiful landlady named Zhu was greatly pleased by the elder sister's words, and her tone became a bit softer. To be honest, she didn't want to chase Xu Qing away. After all, she could still help with some 'small tasks' every month.

Small job?The corridors of the three rental houses are cleaned every day, and I have to change the gas and rice for you. The last time you had a heart attack, I took you to the hospital on my back, but you didn't even have a decent thank you afterwards, and you blamed me for breaking the sling... Xu Qing cursed in her heart, but didn't dare to say a word on her lips. She lowered her head and said weakly: "Sister, my sister-in-law hasn't been paid yet, can you wait until the 15th?"

Although he said this, Xu Qing didn't have the slightest confidence in his heart. He was living a tight life just relying on his sister-in-law's salary of just over a thousand a month. How could he have money to pay the rent?The college entrance examination is about to take place. With Xu Qing's grades, it shouldn't be a big problem to get into a university, but even if he gets into it, the high tuition fees will not be covered.

Looking at Xu Qing's dejected face, the beautiful landlady who had vented was inexplicably frightened in her heart. To be honest, this young man was pretty good. He had a heart attack that day. If it weren't for the fact that he was currently in a square box earning incense and white chrysanthemums, his mood would have improved a lot after spraying him. A feeling of gratitude quietly surged into his heart.

The beautiful landlady pondered for a while and then she had an idea in her mind. The corners of her mouth curved, and a pair of small pear dimples were particularly attractive. Xu Qing's expression was wandering, and he was a little drifting.

"Qingzi, I also know that it's not easy for your sister-in-law. How about I help you with one more errand in the future besides cleaning the corridors? It can cover some expenses. If you do a good job, you can pay back the rent in a month or two..."

Xu Qing's eyes lit up and he raised his head, looking at Sister Zhu intently. After hearing it for a while, he finally understood. It turned out that he was asked to take over various trivial tasks in nearby rental houses, such as changing liquefied gas, opening sewer pipes, transporting, and even tutoring primary and secondary school students. In addition, he could also repair some electrical appliances. If the price was moderate, he would have a lot of potential.

The beautiful landlady became more and more energetic as she talked, and even though she was extremely aggressive in scolding people, whenever she talked about business, her vision and wisdom made people feel amazing. Together with the pair of trembling big breasts on her chest, it was even more amazing.

The two of them stood like this inside and outside the house for almost an hour. Xu Qing's feet felt a little numb, and then he remembered to bring a stool out for Sister Zhu to sit on. Unexpectedly, he just turned around and the beautiful landlady had already sat down on the ground happily.

Xu Qing turned her head when she heard the movement behind her, her expression suddenly stiffened, and she thought to herself, Sister, can't you hold on for just one minute?

It's better now. The beautiful landlady found a place to sit down by herself. Xu Qing was stunned, wondering in her heart, should this stool be moved?Just as he was hesitating, the beautiful landlady sat on the ground and shouted.

"Qingzi, come here and help sister, oh, my waist..."

Xu Qing was stunned, and quickly stepped forward to help Sister Zhu up. Unexpectedly, something went wrong in her busy schedule. A palm passed through the armpit and was clasped on a soft ball. The guy blushed, and quickly pulled his hand back two inches, and finally helped Sister Zhu up.

"Qingzi, don't break my sister's sling again." The beautiful landlord saw Xu Qing blushing and squinted her eyes as she joked.

"No...it's not that, I was accidentally..." Xu Qing's face was as red as a ripe tomato. She wanted to find a hole in the ground and could only hide her embarrassment by lowering her head.

"Haha! It's settled. I'll send you a PHS phone later to use first. If you have any chance, call me..." Zhu Damei had scolded her enough, and she was pinched for no reason. She felt as if she had eaten a piece of pudding in the dog days of summer. She felt comfortable in the pores all over her body, and the smile on her face was so sweet.

"No need! I can't afford the phone bill..." A tune came into Xu Qing's mind, holding a PHS phone, standing in the wind and rain, switching from left hand to right hand, but couldn't get through.

"It's okay. Sister, I'll take care of it for you first. I'll pay you back to me when you make money later." The beautiful landlord was thinking about her little ninety-nine. Now that the economy is in recession, there are far fewer people renting houses. There are still a lot of empty houses in the three rental buildings. If there is an additional housekeeping service, the business of renting houses will also flourish. Don't we also have a competitive advantage?

Thinking of this, the beautiful landlady looked at Xu Qing's strong body with joy. This body is much better than those four-eyed students who fucked. Look at these muscles, tsk tsk... Thinking of the breasts that had been pinched by this hairy boy just now, Danfeng's eyes unknowingly gained a layer of mist.

"This brat is also an honest man with an empty nose and a wick in his belly. The pinch just now almost aroused the fire in my heart. Alas! What happened to me..." The beautiful landlady thought quietly, with an inexplicable emotion in her heart. She had never felt this way since her damn husband died young.

The upset beautiful landlady gently rubbed her eyebrows with her fingers to drive away the strange emotions, and then her heart returned to calm.
